package com.customservants;

/**
 * What happens to the dialogue emote when the servant's chathead is swapped for another NPC's.
 */
public enum ChatheadEmote
{
	/**
	 * Leaves the dialogue's emote playing on the borrowed head.
	 */
	KEEP,
	/**
	 * Clears the chathead widget's animation to -1.
	 */
	NONE
}

package com.customservants;

import net.runelite.api.Model;
import net.runelite.api.NPC;

/**
 * Supplies the model to draw in place of an NPC's own model.
 */
@FunctionalInterface
public interface ModelSubstitutor
{
	/**
	 * @param npc the NPC about to be drawn
	 * @return the model to draw instead, or null to draw the vanilla model
	 */
	Model substitute(NPC npc);
}

package com.customservants;

/**
 * Animation-compatibility class of an NPC's skeleton. Two NPCs on the same rig can play each
 * other's sequences.
 */
public enum Rig
{
	/**
	 * The player/humanoid skeleton (framemap 0) that every player-owned house servant, the Demon
	 * butler included, animates on.
	 */
	HUMAN,
	/**
	 * Any other rig: a different framemap or a skeletal (maya) skeleton.
	 */
	OTHER
}
